title: Evolving Diverse Red-team Language Models in Multi-round Multi-agent Games
reasoning: The paper focuses on the safety alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with 'human values' and 'social moral standards.' It evaluates the models' robustness through a red-teaming framework that specifically probes topics related to ethics and faith, such as 'racist language,' 'racial discrimination,' and 'religion' (as shown in Figure 13 and Figure 14).
